verses: Aasmano aur zamin ki her cheez Allah Taalaa ki paki biyan kerti hai, aur woh ghalib ba-hikmat hai

O hi hai jiss ney ahl kitab mein say kafiron ko unn kay gharon say pehlay hashar kay waqt nikala, tumhara guman (bhi) na tha kay woh niklen gay aur woh khud (bhi) samajh rahey thay kay unn kay (sangeen) qilay unhen Allah (kay azab) say bacha len gay pus unn per Allah (ka azab) aisi jagah say para kay unhen guman bhi na tha aur unn kay dilon mein Allah ney rob daal diya woh apney gharon ko apney hi hathon ujaar rahey thay aur musalmanon kay hathon (barbaad kerwa rahey thay) pus aey aankhon walo! ibrat hasil kero
Aur agar Allah Taalaa ney unn per jila watni ko muqaddar na ker diya hota to yaqeenan unhen duniya hi mein azab deta, aur aakhirat mein (to) unn kay liye aag ka azab hai hi
Yeh uss liye kay unhon ney Allah Taalaa ki aur uss kay rasool ki mukhalifat ki aur jo bhi Allah ki mukhalifat keray ga to Allah Taalaa bhi sakht azab kerney wala hai
Tum ney khujooron kay jo darakht kaat dalay ya jinhen tum ney unn ki jaron per baqi rehney diya. Yeh sab Allah Taalaa kay farman say tha aur uss liye bhi kay fasiqon ko Allah Taalaa ruswa keray

Aur unn ka jo maal Allah Taalaa ney apney rasool kay hath lagaya hai jiss per na to tum ney apney ghoray doraye hain aur na oont balkay)yeh Allah Taalaa apney rasool ko jiss per chahaye ghalib ker deta hai, aur Allah Taalaa her cheez per qadir hai

Bastiyon walon ka jo (maal) Allah Taalaa tumharay laray bhiray baghair apney rasool kay hath lagaye woh Allah ka hai aur rasool ka aur qarabat walon ka aur yateemon miskeenon ka aur musafiron ka hai takay tumharay dolat mandon kay hath mein hi yeh maal gardish kerta na reh jaye aur tumhen jo kuch rasool dey ley lo, aur jiss say rokay ruk jao aur Allah Taalaa say dartay raha kero, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa sakht azab wala hai

(fey ka maal) unn mohajir miskeenon kay liye hai jo apney gharon say aur apney maalon say nikal diye gaye hain woh Allah kay fazal aur uss ki razamandi kay talab gaar hain aur Allah Taalaa ki aur uss kay rasool ki madad kertay hain yehi raast baaz log hain

Aur (unn kay liye) jinhon ney uss ghar mein (yani madina) aur eman mein unn say pehlay jagah bana hai aur apni taraf hijrat kerkay aaney walon say mohabbat kertay hain aur mohajreen ko jo kuch dey diya jaye uss say woh apney dilon mein koi tangi nahi rakhtay balkay)yeh khud apney upper unhen tarjeeh detay hain go khud ko kitni hi sakht hajat ho (baat yeh hai) kay jo bhi apney nafs kay bukhul say bachaya gaya o hi kaamyaab (aur murad) hai

Aur (unn kay liye) jo unn kay baad aayen jo kahen gay kay aey humaray perwerdigar humen bakhsh dey aur humaray unn bhaiyon ko bhi jo hum say pehlay eman chukay hain aur eman daron ki taraf say humaray dil mein keena (aur dushmani) na daal, aey humaray rab be-shak to shafqat o meharbani kerney wala hai

Kiya tu ney munafiqon ko na dekha? Kay apney ahl kitab kafir bhaiyon say kehtay hain agar tum jila watan kiye gaye to zaroor bil-zaroor hum bhi tumharay sath nikal kharay hun gay aur tumharay baray mein hum kabhi bhi kissi ki baat na manen gay aur agar tum say jang ki jaye gi to khuda hum tumhari madad keren gay, lekin Allah Taalaa gawahi deta hai kay yeh qata’an jhootay hain

Agar woh jila-watan kiye gaye to yeh unn kay sath na jayen gay aur agar unn say jang ki gaee to yeh unn ki madad (bhi) na keren gay aur agar (bil-farz) madad per bhi gaye to peeth pher ker (bhaag kharay) hun gay phir madad na kiye jayen gay
(musalmano! yaqeen mano) kay tumhari haibat unn kay dilon mein ba nisbat Allah ki haibat kay boht ziyadah hai, yeh uss liye kay yeh bey samajh log hain

Yeh sab mill ker bhi tum say larr nahi saktay haan yeh aur baat hai kay qila band muqamaat mein hun ya deewaron ki aarr mein hun, unn ki laraee to unn mein aapas mein hi boht sakht hai go aap unhen mutahid samajh rahey hain lekin unn kay dil dar-asal aik doosray say juda hain. Uss liye kay yeh aqal log hain
Unn logon ki tarah jo unn say kuch hi pehlay guzray hain jinhon ney apney kaam ka wabaal chakh liya aur jin kay liye alamnaak azab (tayyar) hai
Shetan ki tarah kay uss ney insan say kaha kufur ker, jab woh kufur ker chuka to kehney laga mein to tujh say buri hun, mein to Allah rab aalameen say darta hun
Pus dono ka anjam yeh hua kay aatish (dozakh) mein hamesha kay liye gaye aur zalimon ki yehi saza hai

Aey eman walo! Allah say dartay raho aur her shakhs dekh (bhaal) ley kay kul (qayamat) kay wastay uss ney (aemaal ka) kiya (zakheera) bheja hai. Aur (her waqt) Allah say dartay raho. Allah tumharay sab aemaal say ba-khabar hai
Aur tum unn logon ki tarah mat ho jana jinhon ney Allah (kay ehkaam) ko bhala diya to Allah ney bhi unhen apni janon say ghafil ker diya, aur aisay hi log nafarman (fasiq) hotay hain
Ahl naar aur ahl jannat (bahum) barabar nahi. Jo ahl jannat hain o hi kaamyaab hain (aur jo ahl naar hain woh nakaam hain)

Agar hum uss Quran ko kissi pahar per utartay to to dekhta kay khof elahi say woh pust hoker tukray tukray ho jata hum unn misalon ko logon kay samney biyan kertay hain takay woh ghor ghor-o-fiker keren
O hi Allah hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi, chupay khulay ka jannay wala meharban aur reham kerney wala

O hi Allah hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi, badshah, nihayat pak, sab aeybon say saaf, aman denay wala, nigehbaan, ghalib zor, aur baraee wala, pak hai Allah unn cheezon say jinhen yeh uss ka shareek banatay hain

O hi Allah hai peda kerney wala wujood bakhshney wala, soorat bananey wala, ussi kay liye (nihayat) achay naam hain, her cheez khuwah woh aasmano mein ho khuwah zamin mein ho uss ki paki biyan kerti hai, aur o hi ghalib hikmat wala hai
